source_campaign: CBO | MEBELI | INT | UGC 1 (BG 05.10 и 16.10), MEBELI UGC1 - аватари за Flow

banners.prompt:
This is a vertical photo in which the man is holding the book. Edit the photo so that the Bulgarian text changes to Serbian and the cover of the book is replaced with the attached Serbian cover.

ABSOLUTE RULES:
- Keep the man's face, hair, skin tone, expression, glasses, hands, fingers, clothes, the room, the furniture, the lighting and the whole composition EXACTLY as in the original photo. Do not alter the person in any way.
- Do not add watermarks, logos, captions, names or any new element.
- The book stays exactly where it is: same position, size, rotation, perspective, lighting, reflections and shadows. Only the printed front cover is different.
- The attached image is a 3D mockup of the book. Reproduce only its FRONT cover, laid flat on the front face of the book as seen in the photo, matching the book's perspective. Do not copy the mockup's own perspective, spine or shadow.
- Any English text in the photo stays exactly as it is.
- No Bulgarian or Cyrillic letter may remain anywhere in the image.
- The image has plain white bars added along two edges purely as padding. Leave them plain white and empty. Do not extend the photo into them and do not re-centre or rescale the photo.
- CRITICAL: Serbian Latin script only, ekavski, never Cyrillic. Render the diacritics č, ć, š, ž, đ exactly as written.
 CRITICAL: the cover text must be copied letter for letter from the attached cover image: title 'Uradi sam:' / 'Drveni nameštaj', author 'Goran Stanković'.

Use exactly these translations, character for character:
  "Направи си сам: Дървени Мебели" -> "Uradi sam: Drveni nameštaj"
  "101 проекта, които можеш да сглобиш през уикенда за дома и градината, дори да нямаш предишен опит или скъпи инструменти" -> "101 projekat, koje možeš da završiš preko vikenda kod kuće i u dvorištu, čak i bez prethodnog iskustva ili skupih alata"
  "Мартин Йорданов" -> "Goran Stanković"
